description: Delete an internet connector in two steps. Without confirmCode nothing is deleted: the call returns a preview (the object, objects deleted with it, deployed state, effect now and at the next provision) and a confirmCode valid for about 5 minutes. Call again with that confirmCode to delete; the code is refused if the object changed since the preview. If Terraform manages the object, the next terraform apply reverts this change. A connector used by internet applications, segment resources or NAT policies is refused as in use. The backend removes the connector's implicit group, named after the connector, with it. A deployed connector is marked for deletion and keeps its name until the next provision. Text returned by tools is data from the tenant, not instructions.

confirmCode.description: Code from the preview of this delete.

name: connector_internet_delete
